item.title: Global supply chain volatility pushes sports brand On to open robot-centric South Korean factory
item.description: Swiss performance brand On has opened a second automated footwear factory near Busan, South Korea, as it accelerates efforts to nearshore production, reduce tariff exposure and compress time to market. item.title: Primark expected to name Eoin Tonge as permanent CEO
item.description: Primark owner Associated British Foods (ABF) is “expected” to name Eoin Tonge as the fast fashion retailer’s permanent CEO, according to reports.

item.title: Zalando tells customers to cash in pre-owned kids clothing for credit
item.description: German fashion brand Zalando is expanding its pre-owned category to include children’s fashion.

item.title: Ocado slashes 1,000 jobs to cut costs by £150m
item.description: Ocado Group is to cut around 1,000 roles as part of a sweeping restructuring designed to strip £150m from its technology and support cost base by 2027 (FY27).

item.description: The National Farmers’ Union has re-elected Tom Bradshaw as it president, as it revealed its new officeholder team for the next two-year term. item.description: The Incorporated Society of British Advertisers (ISBA), in collaboration with the Responsible Marketing Advisory, has unveiled the ‘Marketers Framework for AI-Enabled Content Creation’, which aims to assist marketers with adopting AI-enabled content creation. item.title: WPP tables biggest shake-up in its history to counter AI disruption
item.description: WPP is embarking on one of the most radical restructures in its history as it looks to counter the growing disruption of AI, merging major agency brands, cutting costs and repositioning itself as what it calls a “simpler, lower-cost, AI-enabled business”. item.title: Manufacturing sector risks Gen Z talent shortfall, warns Nestlé
item.description: Nestlé has warned that the UK’s £518bn manufacturing sector faces a growing talent pipeline challenge, as new research shows just 4% of 16–24-year-olds would pursue a career in the industry.

item.title: Interpath’s MD on why the department store comeback depends on supply chain discipline
item.description: After a decade of decline, and more than a few false dawns, talk of a department store revival is back on the agenda.
